notes.title: 🎉 Release Announcement 🎉 New Perspective Launches July 17!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

After months of passion, writing, late-night testing (and blushing scenes), I'm beyond thrilled to announce:

🌟 New Perspective officially releases on Steam on
🗓️ July 17, 2025
🕔 5:00 PM CEST / 11:00 AM EDT / 8:00 AM PDT

I can't wait for you to finally experience the story I’ve poured my heart into.
[hr][/hr]
💋 What is New Perspective?
A branching adult visual novel filled with:

Beautiful Characters

Mature relationships

Intimate moments (18+)

And interesting (and kinky 😳) Storylines

Whether you're here for the romance, the spice, or the story—there’s something waiting for you.
[hr][/hr]
🛒 Where to Get It?
Wishlist and follow the game on Steam now:
👉 New Perspective - Store Page

Every wishlist before launch massively helps push the game into visibility—so thank you in advance! 💖
[hr][/hr]

To make sure you don’t miss the moment:

🇩🇪 Germany / CEST: 5:00 PM
